item.title: Two New AI Approaches for Humanoid Locomotion and Object Transport
item.description:
Two New AI Approaches for Humanoid Locomotion and Object Transport

Two new AI development papers have been submitted to arXiv on 24 and 25 November 2026, introducing novel methods for training humanoid robots in complex locomotion and object transport tasks using reinforcement learning and self-play techniques.

#AI #Robotics #ReinforcementLearning #Humanoid #ComputerVision

Source: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Pursuit Game for Locomotor Agility Pretraining Source: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
